name: BH1745 RGB Color Sensor
description: The Pimoroni breakout board has two white LEDs that light up the object in front of the sensor. They are connected to the `INT` pin of the BH1745, so they can not be switched with a GPIO of your board. The `bh1745` output platform is a [binary output](https://esphome.io/components/output/) that switches the `INT` pin, and with it the LEDs. The component does not use the interrupt feature of the chip for anything else.

config_entries.label: Inverted
config_entries.description: If the output should be treated as inverted. Defaults to `false`.

config_entries.label: Bh1745 ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the `bh1745` hub. Only needed when you have more than one hub.

config_entries.label: Power Supply
config_entries.description: The [power supply](https://esphome.io/components/power_supply/) to connect to this output. When the output is enabled, the power supply will automatically be switched on too.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the output, used to control it.
